draft: The sprawling metropolis of Mexico City pulses with life under a sapphire sky, but also thrums with tension. Armed patrols roam the streets, reflecting an authoritarian grip over the city in recent years. Yet hope persists in covert mutual aid networks and community gardens, as well as innovative solutions to environmental challenges and economic struggles. This city is a testament to resilience amidst adversity, challenges and triumphs that speak to its ever-evolving spirit.
